# Polls sub-actions

## End chat poll

Ends the running chat poll now and announces the result. Good if you want to close a poll early or the poll has no time limit.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if a poll was running and was ended |
| `%winningChoice%` | The text of the winning choice |
| `%totalVotes%` | How many votes there were in all |

<small>Type id: `polls.end`</small>

## Lock, resolve or cancel chat prediction

Locks a running prediction so no more bets come in, or picks the winner and pays out, or cancels it and gives all bets back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Do** | Lock = stop taking bets. Resolve = pick the winner and pay out. Cancel = give every bet back. Options: Lock, Resolve, Cancel. Starts as: `Lock`. |
| **Winning outcome (to resolve)** | Only for Resolve: the winning outcome's number (1, 2...) or its text. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if it worked |
| `%pollId%` | The prediction's internal id |
| `%winningChoice%` | Only after Resolve: the text of the winning outcome |

<small>Type id: `polls.prediction`</small>

## Start chat poll

Starts a poll in your chat. Viewers vote by typing the vote command, like !vote 1. Good for "which game next?" moments.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Question** | The question, like "Which game next?". |
| **Choices** | The answers to choose from, one per line, 2 to 10 of them. Viewers vote by typing !vote 1, !vote 2 and so on. |
| **Seconds (0: until ended)** | How many seconds the poll runs. 0 = until you end it. Starts as: `60`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if the poll started |
| `%pollId%` | The poll's internal id |

<small>Type id: `polls.start`</small>

## Start chat prediction

Starts a prediction: viewers bet their points on what will happen, for example if you win the next round. Needs Cuebot points to be set up.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Question** | The question, like "Will I win this round?". |
| **Outcomes** | The possible results, one per line, 2 to 10 of them. Viewers bet by typing !bet 1 500 or !bet 2 all (outcome number, then points). |
| **Seconds taking bets (0: until locked)** | How many seconds viewers can bet. 0 = until you lock the prediction. Starts as: `120`. |
| **Points currency** | The name of the points to bet with, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if the prediction started |
| `%pollId%` | The prediction's internal id |

<small>Type id: `polls.startPrediction`</small>
